content: A mbanu Yasu ad dadak mǝtsa tlapel vǝgh
Ka dagh Yasu da peryu, ka darghǝr kǝ dǝlven kǝ daks da kǝs ai ɗakdin

Sa tsitar da khuɗkǝs ka ɓardǝghǝr yakhaya kǝ udakh ad dadak mǝtsa tlapel vǝgh ǝn khǝngan ǝnt khindz. Katlga kǝ Yasu ad fadǝghǝro fǝga tar, ka niya kǝ dadak mǝtsa tlapel vǝghen, “Ndiɗ biya zǝrara, a ɓisakhanud khaipagh.”
Tsǝna tsitar yana, ka nǝv chalǝm li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh Mus ǝn tǝb tar, “Ina kǝ uda ǝn nena Yazhigǝl.”
Tsa kǝ Yasu ad dǝge ǝn ɗaya itar ghǝr ǝn tǝf, ka niya tsitar, “Uɗa lava tsukur ǝn dzam dǝge ghwaɗghwaɗan ǝn rǝvur ndǝk ini?
Ira ngulman ra, ‘A ɓisakhanud khaipakhagha nagha,’ awana, ‘Tsiya dǝg dǝgal khi’?
Ai ǝn na ka tsatsǝg tsukur kwarne, ka Zer Ud nǝg ka dǝ ndzǝɗ ǝn lard na kǝ ɓisa khaipakh.” Ka niya kǝ dadak mǝtsa tlapel vǝgh, “Tsiyǝf tsiy, ɓa khindza daks da mǝgh.”
Tǝvin tǝvina, ka tsiyif udanena ka daks tsin da fǝta sar.
Vazga kǝ dzakhava udakha ndǝkyana ka gǝdzǝf itar, ka ɗabanǝf itar Yazhigǝle bara khulfina kǝ ndzǝɗa kǝ udakh.
A ɗakhga Yasu ad Matiyu
Ɗuwars kǝ Yasu ad vaken, madǝvin ǝn zu vuk dǝ dǝg, ka nǝghan ad udanen ai ɗakhud dǝ Matiyu, ǝn ndzǝgan tǝvak chau khadam, ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “gataks gat.” Ka tsiyifa gatars.
Ən tǝ khal kǝ yan, madǝv Yasu ǝn zu kaf ǝn fata Matiyu, ka saks li chau khadam zǝ li khaipakh zikǝn saks da vak sar ndzakhga itar kǝ zu kaf dagha zǝ furakh sar.
Nǝgha kǝ Farisakh ndǝkyan, ka nǝv itar kǝ furakh sar, “Uɗa lava kǝ malǝmura ǝn zu kaf zǝ li chau khadam zǝ li khaipakhi?”
Tsǝna kǝ Yasu dina ka ni, “Na li lapi ǝn gat dadak ngura bi, uk liye kwal yang.
Dam da tsag dǝge ǝn tuku lavan, ‘Kwiɗkwirva ǝn nak ǝn vakur, dǝg tsufa bi.’ A sau kǝ ɗakh liye man dǝge ǝn nagha Yazhigǝl ba ka bi, a sau kǝ ɗakh li man khaip kǝ.”
Ndiɗǝn tǝghǝr kǝ zǝɓ ndǝl
Fitsa tlǝrna, ka sasǝg kǝ zar ɓǝlakh Yukhan dadak para ud da vak Yasu, ka nǝv itar tsin, “A manga ndar kǝnda zǝ Fariskha ǝn zǝɓ ndǝla, zar ɓǝlagha na ba itar ǝn zǝɓ ndǝl biyi?”
Ka ngawa tǝrkhai Yasu kwarne, “Da manawa ndar bazdu rǝv kǝ tsaghwakh zil ghaula, dlaitar dagha zǝ zil ghauli? Ən saks sarte da ɓatǝrvalud ad zǝ zil ghaul. Da zǝɓ ǝn tǝ sarta yan itar ndǝl.
“Na ude da ndzǝgharu wilwa lǝgwit kǝ mughura gabag bi, wirva vak ndzǝghena da takwalva, kukha sar tsuguna da mala mala ad ai tsa chak.

Na ude da ɗi wilwa yu inabi da mughura mbǝl vigh bi. Itsa ka ɗidaghud, da chaɓa mbǝl vighen, ka da ɗiya yu inabi, mbǝl vighen tsuguna da baz, azǝgha ɗaidagh ud ad wilwa yu inabi da wilwa mbǝl vigh. Wirva yana nabe da bǝghalud ǝmb bi.”
A mbanu Yasu ad dugh Yayirus zǝ nuse kǝl vizh
Ən tǝghǝr kǝ kwara tǝra yan kǝ lava Yasu ma, ka sasǝg kǝ mal ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, ka kǝlgan ad juguv ǝn tǝvuk sar ka ni, “Amtsǝga dughwar a zulava bi, ausǝg da bo dǝv ǝn tǝf da tsi”
Ka tsiyif Yasu zǝ furakh sar, ka gatars itar kǝ udanen.
Ka nǝg tlǝrna nus ai manga vǝg kǝlatǝm mits ǝn tukw kuza kǝl vizh, ka sagh du ligsar ka gǝman ad ghay gabag sar.
Ni ǝn rǝvakhud sar, “Da gǝma ka itsa gabag sar da mbǝga kǝ.”
Gwifkhai kǝ Yasu ka nǝghan, ka ni, “Ndiɗ biya dughwara. Fadǝghǝro fǝgagha kǝ mbakhu.” Ən tǝvin tǝvin ka mbu nusen.
Sa kǝ Yasu da fǝta mal ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, ka nǝgha nǝgha tsin liye fǝg fakil zǝ dzakhava udakh ǝn kwara kava ghay sikh sikh sikh.
Ka ni, “Tsiyam tsiyǝn van. Amtsǝga ba dughuna bi, ǝn khǝn khara sar.” Ka nenanef itar dǝ ghǝɓas.
Ai lakwtǝrdal tsud da mel, ka dagh khutanan ad dǝva dughwen, ka tsiyif.
A kwazga laven itsa dǝvar ǝn kǝsen.
A mbanu Yasu ad ngulfakha zǝ li khutsan tlim
Ba Yasu ǝn ɗuda vaken ma, ka gatars ngulfakh mits ǝn ɗakha itar dǝ ndzǝɗa kwarne, “Zǝr Doda ziwa kǝndal ziwa.”
Da kǝ Yasu da mǝgha ka sagh ngulfakhen da vak sar, ka niya tsitsar, “A fadǝghǝro nagh kur kwarne tǝkhaka kǝ mbakuruwa?” Ka nǝv itar, “Aa, tǝkha kha Dadzikan.”
Tǝkhal kǝ yana ka gǝman ad diyakh tar ka ni, “Ən tǝ dǝva dǝ fadǝghǝro fǝgura da mbakura mbǝgud.”
Ka ngwarǝf diyakh tar. Ka tǝkhatǝrna Yasu char kwarne, “Kwara mara ba kǝ itsawar ad ina kǝ digit bi.”
Ai dala tsitar, ka kwazdu itar ad lava itsa dǝvar ǝn kǝsen.
Madǝv itar dǝgal, ka ɓardǝghǝrud ad ude kwal tǝkha kǝ kwarga lav, dadake dǝ sǝɗikw bǝzan ǝn vǝgh sar.
Lakwadal tsud sǝɗikw bǝzanen, ine tsa kwar tǝkha kǝ kwarga lav ka farsa kwar lav. A ndawatrǝf kǝ dzakhava udakh ka nǝv itar, “Tsa tapa bud nǝgha khulfinak digit ǝn khaya ya Izrail bi.”
Ai ka nǝv Farisakh, “Afke ǝn zaɓado dǝ ndzǝɗa zikan na kǝ mal ya wurdu ad sǝɗikw bǝzanena.”
A manga Yasu ad kwiɗkwiɗǝrva udakh

A dakhal Yasu da kǝsakh daghan zǝ gǝdzar kǝsakh, ǝn tsagdu tsag ǝn gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, ǝn tlǝkhdu lav zǝɗan ai tǝghǝr kǝ tlǝksa Yazhigǝl, tsuguna ǝn mbakha udakh zikǝn, zǝ itsera kǝ khulf kuzakh zǝ li kuɗ lapi.
“Nǝgha tsin udakh a dzavkhai zikǝn, ka kwiɗ nǝv rǝv tsin, wirva ǝn khǝɓ dlaɗ itar na ude ǝn mǝlatǝru mǝla bi, ngwaɗa tuwaghakh itar kwal nǝg kǝ dadak zighwtǝr zighw.”
“Ka niya kǝ furakh sar, zikǝn tsǝg khi, li man tlǝr tsuguna khǝɗikǝn.
Wirva yan, takaɗam takaɗa Dadzikan dadake nǝgharu kǝ tlǝr gukhen, kǝ ɓǝlondagh li man tlǝr kǝ tsara khi.”
